title: A la nanita nana
artist: José Ramón Gomis / Juan Francisco Muñoz y Pabón
attribution: Published in Madrid in 1904 as "La nana, balada al Niño Jesús", music by José Ramón Gomis (died 1939), words by Juan Francisco Muñoz y Pabón (died 1920); sung here in the form that passed into Spanish oral tradition as a carol and lullaby. Both authors died more than 80 years ago, so melody and words are public domain. The middle section turns to D major, so its F sharps, C sharps and B naturals are expected to show as out-of-key.
